risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and strongly quantified, with detailed revenue, margin, bookings, acquisition, restructuring, tax, and divestiture impacts. Risk tone is moderately positive, although dependence on acquisitions, energy-market activity, restructuring, product recalls, and execution of the Wellsite separation present meaningful risks. The introductory forward-looking disclaimer and recurring attribution language are standard boilerplate rather than substantial obfuscation.
